Crisanta (Bianca Umali) and Antonia (Jean Garcia) were kicked out of their boarding house because they weren't allowed to have a companion. The two then went their separate ways. While Crisanta was walking along the street looking for a place to stay, she was shocked to see Cheska (Kyline Alcantara) and immediately hugged her.

For more Kambal Karibal Full Episodes, click the link below:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLcKGO4bfjih4

Kambal, Karibal is a riveting tale of family and love that also transcends into the supernatural realm.

It tells the story of twins Crisanta and Criselda. Unfortunately, Criselda dies because of a rare disease and remains a spirit that only appears to Crisanta. However, their close bond will start to fall apart when they both fall in love with Diego. The rivalry between them builds up when their mother’s affections are focused on Crisanta. Eventually, Criselda’s emotions finally consume her and her soul finds another person’s body to inhabit. Now that she is “alive”, she is stopping at nothing to take both her mother’s affection and Diego’s love.
